title: MemReread: Enhancing Agentic Long-Context Reasoning via Memory-Guided Rereading
abstract: arXiv:2605.10268v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long-context reasoning tasks have motivated agent-memory approaches that process document chunks sequentially while maintaining a dynamically updated memory, avoiding the quadratic complexity of standard attention. Existing methods often rely on retrieval to recover information discarded during memory overwriting, but remain vulnerable to evidence loss during memory formation and interference from invalid queries. To overcome these limitations, we propose MemReread. Built upon streaming reading, it circumvents intermediate retrieval, triggering question decomposition and targeted rereading when the final memory is insufficient. By recovering indirect evidence that may have been prematurely discarded, MemReread enables non-linear reasoning while preserving the logical flow of document comprehension. translated_title: MemReread：通过记忆引导的重读增强智能体长上下文推理
translated_abstract: 长上下文推理任务推动了智能体记忆方法的发展，这类方法按顺序处理文档块并维护一个动态更新的记忆，从而避免了标准注意力机制的二次方复杂度。现有方法通常依赖检索来恢复记忆覆盖过程中被丢弃的信息，但在记忆形成过程中仍然容易丢失证据，并且容易受到无效查询的干扰。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了MemReread。该方法建立在流式阅读之上，规避了中间检索，当最终记忆不足以回答问题时，会触发问题分解和针对性重读。通过恢复可能被过早丢弃的间接证据，MemReread在保持文档理解逻辑流程的同时实现了非线性推理。我们进一步引入了一个强化学习框架，该框架提升了长度外推能力，并能自适应地确定重读的次数。
tldr: MemReread通过在最终记忆不充分时触发问题分解与针对性重读，恢复流式阅读中被过早丢弃的间接证据，从而在不依赖中间检索的情况下增强智能体的长上下文非线性推理能力，并结合强化学习提升长度外推能力和重读次数的自适应决策。
en_tdlr: MemReread enhances agentic long-context reasoning by triggering question decomposition and targeted rereading when the final memory is insufficient, recovering prematurely discarded indirect evidence without intermediate retrieval, further supported by a reinforcement learning framework that improves length extrapolation and adaptively decides the number of rereadings.
